all examinations, audits, inquiries or investigations

initiated by the Central Bank or such officer under
this Act;
all contracts, deeds, bonds, agreements, guarantees,
powers of attorney, grants of legal representation
and other instruments of whatever nature entered
into by the Central Bank, the Monetary Board or
any other officer of the Central Bank authorized by
the  Monetary  Board  under  the  repealed  Act,  and
subsisting and having effect on the day immediately
preceding  the  appointed  date  and  to  which  the
Central  Bank  or  the  Monetary  Board  or  any
authorized officer is a party or which are in favour
